problem: Lack of automated toll fare aggregation via Fastag API and dynamic fuel cost splitting based on vehicle mileage among passengers within the budget planning features.
root_cause: Budget and expense tracking services currently only handle static manual entries without integration for real-time fuel price lookups, toll aggregators, or per-passenger split distribution logic.
architecture: Backend service architecture utilizing a new fuel price provider provider/service and a Fastag API integration module within budgetService.js to compute total trip transit expenses, which are then surfaced through the mobile budget screen interface for passenger cost splitting.
recommended_solution: Implement fuelPriceProvider.js to fetch current local fuel rates based on route coordinates/region, build a toll fare aggregator utilizing Fastag API specs in budgetService.js, and update budget_screen.dart to provide interactive passenger mileage/cost splitting controls.
risks: External Fastag or fuel price API rate limits or downtime
Inaccurate vehicle mileage inputs leading to unfair cost splits
UI layout overflow on mobile when displaying complex split breakdowns
acceptance_criteria: Fuel costs are accurately calculated using distance, vehicle mileage, and real-time fuel prices.
Toll plaza fares are successfully aggregated via the Fastag API integration.
Total travel expenses (fuel + tolls) are dynamically split among passengers based on configured shares.
The Flutter mobile budget screen reflects real-time updates when passengers or vehicle details change.

test_cases.name: test_fuel_cost_calculation
test_cases.description: Verify that fuelCostProvider computes correct fuel expenses given distance, fuel efficiency, and regional fuel prices.

test_cases.name: test_toll_fare_aggregation
test_cases.description: Validate that budgetService successfully queries the Fastag API mock/stub and aggregates total route tolls.

test_cases.name: test_budget_screen_split_ui
test_cases.description: Confirm that budget_screen.dart correctly displays passenger cost splits and updates dynamically upon user input modifications.
